name: Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor
author: Wow Elements

sections.description:
Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor is a feature-rich plugin crafted to supercharge the Elementor page builder with advanced slider widgets that are both powerful and easy to use. Ideal for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users, Wow Sliders enables you to create visually stunning, fully responsive sliders that enhance user engagement and elevate your website’s design.

Whether you’re building a blog, an online store, or a business website, Wow Sliders gives you complete control over your content presentation with highly customizable sliders. The plugin offers:

🎯 Dynamic Content Sliders – Automatically pull content from your blog posts, products, or custom post types into elegant, animated sliders.

🛒 WooCommerce Product Sliders – Showcase your products with beautifully designed carousels and promotional sliders that increase conversions.

🎥 Video & Image Sliders – Add multimedia-rich sliders with smooth transitions, lightbox options, and autoplay controls.

🖼️ Hero Sliders – Create impactful landing sections with full-width hero sliders and interactive call-to-action buttons.

💡 Wow Sliders – Powerful Slider Widgets for Elementor

Wow Sliders extends Elementor with a set of lightweight, performance-focused slider widgets designed to enhance your website’s creativity and usability — without sacrificing speed.

🎯 **FREE WIDGETS COLLECTION**

Categories match the Wow Sliders admin (Wow Sliders → Slider Widgets): Content, Creative, Posts / Dynamic, and WooCommerce.

📄 Content

  1. Image Carousel – Showcase images with clean, responsive carousel layouts.
  2. Hero Showcase – Create bold hero sections with visual storytelling slides.

🎨 Creative

  1. Expo – Highlight key content with modern presentation-style transitions.
  2. Material – Add material-inspired slider designs with smooth animation flow.
  3. Shutters – Use dramatic shutter transitions for eye-catching slide changes.
  4. Kornel – Build creative sliders with flexible text and media blocks.
  5. Pixora – Display image-heavy content using artistic slide arrangements.
  6. Lumix – Present photography and portfolio visuals in stylish compositions.
  7. Testimo – Present testimonials and social proof in animated slider cards.
  8. Nexis – Create clean showcase sliders for business-focused pages.
  9. Drivox – Build interactive image-content sliders with thumb navigation.
  10. Nexa – Build modern slider sections with elegant content alignment.
  11. Elron – Display marketing content in a sleek call-to-action slider.
  12. Minora – Add minimal, content-first sliders for simple page sections.
  13. Nexora – Design premium hero sliders with layered content effects.
  14. Corex – Create professional slider layouts for products and services.

🚀 **PRO WIDGETS COLLECTION**

🎨 Creative

  1. Super Flow – Create advanced motion sliders with fluid transitions.
  2. Neptune – Design fluid full-width sliders with modern transitions.
  3. Uranus – Build modern interactive sliders with immersive movement.
  4. Saturn – Showcase layered media content with smooth interactions.
  5. Jupiter – Build versatile multipurpose sliders for business websites.
  6. Mars – Build energetic promotional sliders for campaign sections.
  7. Earth – Present natural, balanced content with smooth transitions.
  8. Venus – Present elegant brand messaging with clean slide design.
  9. Phobos – Add sharp, fast transitions for campaign highlights.
  10. Ganymede – Build polished content sliders for premium landing pages.
  11. Enceladus – Showcase featured content in dynamic promotional slides.
  12. Oberon – Present editorial content with premium animated flow.
  13. Sputnik – Build futuristic-looking sliders with strong visual depth.
  14. Amalthea – Craft cinematic full-screen sliders with layered typography.
  15. Mimas – Use compact content sliders for lightweight page sections.
  16. Sinope – Design stylish slider blocks for creative projects.
  17. Elara – Build immersive hero sliders with elegant motion effects.
  18. Lapetus – Design minimal premium sliders with smooth interactions.
  19. Ariel – Build clean hero transitions with bold content positioning.
  20. Larissa – Present brand content in elegant, modern slider frames.
  21. Galileo – Display modern showcase sliders with layered design style.
  22. Kepler – Create clean marketing sliders focused on conversion goals.

📰 Posts / Dynamic

  1. Odio – Build dynamic content sliders with engaging movement.
  2. Moon – Build soft visual sliders for lifestyle and portfolio pages.
  3. Deimos – Use modern split-content slides for product highlights.
  4. Europa – Create high-impact campaign sliders with strong visuals.
  5. Callisto – Display editorial-style slides with premium visual rhythm.
  6. Titan – Use bold, high-contrast slider sections for promotions.
  7. Himalia – Present large-format imagery with cinematic transitions.
  8. Miranda – Create refined slider experiences for agency websites.
  9. Proteus – Create adaptive sliders with flexible content structures.
  10. Chandra – Create elegant slider stories for brands and portfolios.
  11. Dracula – Add dark-themed creative sliders for dramatic presentation.
  12. Astric – Deliver full-viewport post stories with custom navigation and strong visual rhythm.
  13. Corevia – Pair a main slide with vertical thumbs, optional video, and smooth content handoff.
  14. Solvar – Feature editorial posts with date-bar accents and split hero-to-footer flow.
  15. Aerion – Build layered hero post sliders with thumb navigation and rich meta.
  16. Nerolia – Present magazine-style posts with zoom-on-hover imagery and clean typography.

🛒 WooCommerce

  1. Jephira – Showcase products in a thumbnail-driven carousel with hover-friendly layouts.
  2. Oryxen – Highlight store items in a modern coverflow-style product slider.
  3. Godzilla – Use oversized, high-impact sliders for strong messaging.
  4. Kongar – Add experimental transitions for standout visual storytelling.
  5. Medusa – Add artistic effects and creative content arrangements.
  6. Wolf – Add strong, edgy slider styling for standout pages.

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload wow-sliders-addons-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor and searching for “Wow Sliders” widgets.
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WordPress themes?

  • Yes, Wow Sliders Addons for Elementor is compatible with all WordPress themes including popular free and premium Elementor themes.

What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Wow Sliders along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential slider widgets to help you create stunning pages in minutes.

Can I enable or disable individual widgets?

  • Yes! Head to Wow Sliders → Widgets in your WordPress admin dashboard. You can toggle each widget on or off individually, helping you keep your site lean and fast.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

  • Of course, we provide detailed documentation and video tutorials to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and widgets.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support?

  • When we release an update version, you will automatically get a notification in the WordPress plugin manager so you can update from there. If you want to update manually, just contact us and we will send you the update version via email.
